criteria.requirement: The current step, completed step, and remaining steps are distinguishable without relying on color alone.
Workspace setup is the clear primary task and secondary navigation does not compete with it.
Editing the workspace name produces an immediate, legible, sanitized workspace URL preview.
Channel options explain their consequence and expose an unambiguous selected state.
A valid invite can be added, displayed, and removed with understandable feedback.
Required and invalid values block continuation and produce specific inline error messages.
The distinction between skipping invites, saving progress, going back, and continuing is clear.
The interface tells the user what continuing will do without adding a disruptive confirmation step.
All content and controls remain readable, ordered, and usable at both required viewports.
Labels, focus indicators, keyboard order, status messaging, and touch targets are usable and inspectable.
